Favors tagged "thane" in this section count even if done earlier.
hints: Easiest: give a coin to Dervenin, Noster or Svari, sell crops to Katla or Azzada, chop wood for Hjorunn or Horgeir, deliver Sorex's rum.

items.title: Finn's Lute
items.location: Solitude, Bards College; Stony Creek Cave
items.description: Thieves stole the very first eight-course lute from the College. Recover it from Stony Creek Cave in Eastmarch. Reward: +1 to all Stealth skills.
hints: The chest with the lute is just past the first right turn in the cave.

items.title: Pantea's Flute
items.location: Solitude, Bards College; Hob's Fall Cave
items.description: A student stole Pantea's heirloom flute and sold it to a necromancer who believed it makes the dead dance. Recover it from Hob's Fall Cave in Winterhold Hold. Reward: +1 to all Magic skills.
hints: In the corridor with magic traps, pull the soul gems out of the pedestals to switch them off.

items.title: Rjorn's Drum
items.description: The legendary battle drummer Rjorn vanished in Halldir's Cairn. Find his drum for Giraud. Reward: +1 to all Combat skills.
hints: The crypt key lies next to the journal near the Cairn's entrance; a lever behind the throne opens the barred passage.
Halldir splits into ghostly copies during the fight — destroy the copies first, then him.

items.title: No News is Good News
items.description: Angeline asks you to find out from Captain Aldis what happened to her daughter, who serves in the Legion.
items.missable: Captain Aldis dies in the "Battle for Solitude" during the Stormcloak campaign, after which the quest can't be completed.

items.title: Rare Gifts (Aldis)
items.description: Captain Aldis wants a copy of the book "The Mirror". Bring him one. Reward: gold.
hints: The marker points to the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm — taking it there is theft, but Aldis accepts a stolen copy.
items.missable: Aldis dies in the "Battle for Solitude" during the Stormcloak campaign — after that the quest is unavailable.

items.title: Kill the Vampire
items.description: The court wizard asks you to wipe out a vampire nest in Pinemoon Cave west of Solitude. Reward: jewelry and a free Illusion lesson.
hints: Killing the Master Vampire at the altar in the third chamber is enough; his helpers may raise the corpse on the nearby table.

items.title: The Spiced Wine
items.location: Solitude, marketplace; East Empire Company Warehouse
items.description: The East Empire Company is holding up a spice shipment for Evette's famous wine. Persuade or bribe Vittoria Vici by the warehouse at the docks. Reward: 25 gold and 2 bottles of Spiced Wine.
items.missable: The quest disappears after the Dark Brotherhood quest "Bound Until Death" (Vittoria Vici's murder).

items.title: A Few Words with You (Octieve)
items.description: Old Octieve owes money to Irnskar Ironhand. Persuade, bribe or intimidate Irnskar into forgiving the debt. Reward: +1 Two-handed.
tips: Only one "A Few Words with You" quest can be active at a time across Skyrim.
hints: Irnskar is usually around his house or in the Winking Skeever; a failed intimidation leads to a brawl.

items.title: Kill the Bandit Leader (Ahtar)
items.description: Solitude's headsman Ahtar let a prisoner, Captain Hargar, escape. Kill Hargar in Broken Oar Grotto. Reward: gold, and Ahtar becomes available as a follower.
items.missable: If you kill Hargar earlier (in "Lights Out!" or just clearing the grotto), Ahtar won't offer this quest. Take it on your first visit to Solitude.

items.title: Dungeon Delving (Noster)
items.description: The old Legion veteran turned beggar asks you to recover his helmet from a cave in Haafingar. Reward: +1 Sneak.
hints: Noster's Helmet is in one of: Broken Oar Grotto, Steepfall Burrow or Shadowgreen Cavern.
If it's Broken Oar Grotto, you can combine it with "Lights Out!" and Ahtar's quest.

items.title: Delivery (Sorex)
items.location: Solitude, The Winking Skeever; Blue Palace
items.description: The innkeeper's son Sorex asks you to take a bottle of Stros M'Kai Rum to Falk Firebeard in the Blue Palace. Reward: some gold.
tips: Afterwards you can marry Sorex.

items.title: Return to Grace
items.location: Solitude, Addvar's House; Hall of the Dead catacombs
items.description: Little Svari's mother Greta stopped going to the temple after her brother Roggvir's execution. Get Roggvir's Amulet of Talos so she'll go back. Reward: gold.
hints: For three days after the execution Roggvir's body lies by the block; later it's in a coffin in the catacombs behind Solitude's Hall of the Dead.

items.title: Fit for a Jarl
items.description: The tailor Taarie wants to promote her clothes: wear her outfit and show it to Jarl Elisif. Reward: gold and Radiant Raiment fine clothes.
hints: Put the outfit on before talking to Elisif, then ask for her opinion.

items.title: Dragon's Breath Mead
items.description: Olda found out her husband Horgeir keeps a drink stash guarded by wolves. Bring her the bottle of Dragon's Breath Mead. Reward: gold.
hints: Before the bridge turn right, pass the mill, cross the river and follow a trail west — the stash is under an overhanging rock guarded by three wolves.

options.label: Olda
options.result: Olda pays gold; counts toward Thane of Haafingar. Horgeir stops buying firewood from you.

options.label: Horgeir
options.result: Horgeir trains you in Block, but the quest counts as failed.

items.title: Quest all Beggars Have (Solitude)
items.description: Give a coin to Dervenin by the Temple of the Divines or to Svari — they like you more and you get The Gift of Charity.

items.title: Quest all Drunks Have (Razelan)
items.description: At the embassy party during Diplomatic Immunity you can offer the drunk Razelan a drink — he causes a scene and distracts the guests.
tips: Doesn't count toward Thane of Haafingar.

items.title: Gather Wheat (Haafingar)
items.location: Katla's Farm near Solitude; Dragon Bridge
items.description: Farmers buy the crops grown on their fields: wheat, potatoes, cabbage, leeks.

items.title: Chop Wood (Haafingar)
items.description: Chop firewood at a chopping block and sell it — 5 gold per piece.

items.title: Forbidden Legend
items.location: Folgunthur, Saarthal, Geirmund's Hall, Reachwater Rock
items.description: Collect the three pieces of the Gauldur Amulet and reforge it at Reachwater Rock after fighting the three Gauldurson brothers. Reward: the Gauldur Amulet.
tips: The Saarthal fragment is easiest to grab during the College quest "Under Saarthal".

items.title: A Return to Your Roots
items.location: Blackreach, Sinderion's Field Laboratory; Sarethi Farm
items.description: After picking a Crimson Nirnroot in Blackreach, continue the alchemist Sinderion's research: gather 30 roots and take them to Avrusa Sarethi. Reward: the Sinderion's Serendipity ability (chance to brew an extra potion).
tips: Some roots grow in unreachable spots — Whirlwind Sprint can get you there.
hints: Sinderion's laboratory is across from the gates of Alftand Cathedral in Blackreach; his journal is there.
Avrusa Sarethi lives at Sarethi Farm near Riften.

items.title: Evil in Waiting
items.description: Valdar's ghost is holding back the dragon priest Hevnoraak. Empty the three vessels of the priest's blood and destroy him. Reward: the Hevnoraak mask.

items.title: Infiltration
items.description: Sneak into bandit-held Treva's Watch through a secret tunnel and open the gate for Stalleo's men.

items.title: The Words of Power
items.giver: The Greybeards, Esbern, Paarthurnax and others
items.description: Repeatable directions to Word Walls. A handy way to find new shout words.
tips: Esbern (after the main quest) and the Greybeards will tell you where to look for walls.

items.title: Amulet of the Moon
items.description: Bandits stole the caravan guard Kharjo's heirloom amulet. Recover it from a random bandit hideout. Reward: gold, and Kharjo becomes available as a follower.
tips: Caravan Khajiit aren't hold citizens — this doesn't count toward any thane title.
hints: Ahkari's caravan stops outside Dawnstar and Riften — it's easiest to wait for it at one of those cities.

items.title: The Forgemaster's Fingers
items.location: Orc strongholds: Dushnikh Yal, Mor Khazgur, Narzulbur
items.description: To be let into an Orc stronghold as an outsider, find the Forgemaster's Fingers (+12 Smithing) and give them to the chief. Reward: Blood-Kin status and entry to all strongholds.
tips: Blood-Kin is easier to get from "Skilled Apprenticeship", "Coated in Blood" or "Kolskeggr Mine" in Markarth.
hints: Orc characters and players already Blood-Kin don't get this quest; in Largashbur it's replaced by "The Cursed Tribe".
While this quest is active, other Orcs won't make you Blood-Kin.
